issues.reason: The distributive-universal pattern carries the clause's tense inside the conclusion ("All the students passed" -> (Past (sk_pass $x)), and Reciprocals repeats "put any tense/status inside the consequent"), so omitting (Past (sk_salt_bloom $x)) drops the stated past and leaves the Status-predicates unmarked default, i.e. a generic/habitual claim.

The verb class symbol is the very symbol the mass noun of the previous sentence carries with (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom), so the engine's member-of-a-subclass rule derives (Member (sk_salt_bloom $x) bloom) -- an event asserted to be a bloom, which is ill-typed and false whatever the coverage status of the construction.

Complements of nouns and adjectives prescribes the surface-preposition oblique on the reified state witness ((Of sk_full_1 silt) for "full of silt"), and Instrument is reserved for the means an event is performed by -- an agentless whiteness state performs nothing by means of the rime, so the licensed atom is (With sk_white_1 rime).

Coordination & plurals and Quantifiers both require a distributive predicate over a grouped plural ("the dogs barked") to add the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) rule beside the group event, and "add" is distributive rather than collective, so the rule is mandatory and missing.

gaps_confirmed: a denominal verb whose base noun is a compound: lemmatization maps "salt-bloom" (substance) and "was salt-bloomed" (verb) onto one symbol, and the mandatory compound genus on the noun then reaches the reified event -- nothing in the vocabulary separates a noun-kind symbol from a verb-class symbol

the same participle predicative ("was salt-bloomed" -> verb, hence an event) vs attributive ("the salt-bloomed lanterns" -> the property salt_bloomed): the function test in Names and casing mandates the split and no licensed link relates the two records of one fact

a bare non-deictic season adjunct ("in winter"): the structured Time terms stop at Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and the season forms named are only deictic ("last spring", "next summer"), so a bare season has no licensed granularity term
new_gaps: a day-of-year calendar ("on day 92 of Year 1"): the Time term (Day <n>) is the day-of-month slot, so a day-numbered-within-the-year reading can only be recorded by overloading it -- no licensed term distinguishes the two

a universal restricted by an entity-attached locative ("every lantern on the Cliff Path" -> premise (On $x cliff_path)) cannot reach a later definite plural of the same things ("the lanterns of the Cliff Path" -> a group witness with (Possession <group> cliff_path)): no licensed form ties a restricted universal's range to a co-referring group, so the rules never fire on the passage's own lanterns
defect_summary: The "every lantern ... was salt-bloomed" rule's conclusion must carry (Past (sk_salt_bloom $x)) as a conjunct; the salt_bloom noun/verb symbol collision has NO licensed compliant form (lemmatization fixes the event class and the compound genus on the noun is mandatory, so the false (Member <event> bloom) derivation is unavoidable -- filed as the first confirmed gap); "white with rime" must be the surface-preposition oblique (With sk_white_1 rime) on the state witness instead of Instrument; and the keepers' adding needs the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1) (And (Member (sk_add $x) add) (Agent (sk_add $x) $x) (Theme (sk_add $x) salt_bloom) (Goal (sk_add $x) sk_mire_essence_1) (Time (sk_add $x) winter) (Past (sk_add $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event.
notes: The reviewer's own notes are right that the (On ...) / (Possession ...) split leaves the universal rules unable to reach the lanterns actually introduced; I have filed that as a gap rather than a defect since both heads are the doctrine-mandated surface forms. The Ordinal, the natural-force Patient subjects, the dusk/dawn Start-End interval, the Cliff Path name-plus-kind handling and the "stayed lit" continuation copular are all correct.
